title: Figure 6: Ratios of Mach Number, Temperature, and Pressure Across a Normal Shock
description: Graph versus upstream Mach number M (1-10) showing temperature ratio Tratio(M) as a solid red line, pressure ratio Pratio(M) as a dotted curve rising toward about 115, and downstream Mach number M2(M) as a green dashed curve on a right-hand axis (0-1) that drops and levels near 0.38. Text notes that above Mach 5 the Mach ratio approaches a constant value of 0.378.
